title: Jonas Brothers Barely Audible Over Screaming Fans During Spirited Banana Bowl 9th Inning Performance
summary: The trio performed hits old and new while rocking out with the Banana Ball Championship League players.
contentText:
The Jonas Brothers ‘ latest performance was totally bananas. At the inaugural Banana Bowl in Washington, D.C., Kevin, Joe and Nick delivered a high-energy medley of their hits on the field, at certain points struggling to compete volume-wise with the intense cheers from fans watching the show.

During the ninth-inning performance on Saturday (Oct. 10) — which the Savannah Bananas baseball team posted in full on YouTube — the JoBros opened with some of their classics. Leading with “Burnin’ Up” followed by Camp Rock banger “Play My Music,” the trio segued into later hits such as “Waffle House” and Billboard Hot 100 topper “Sucker” while strutting from one end of the field to the next.

At different points in the performance, the band was joined by the six different teams in the Banana Ball Championship League, the players for which clearly had lots of fun making up dance moves to display while accompanying the JoBros. During other moments — most notably when a crowd of fans was welcomed onto the field to receive autographs from the guys — it was difficult to hear the music over the audience’s excited, banana-splitting screams. (If anything, it added to the fun of the performance.)

The first-ever Banana Bowl closed out with the Texas Tailgaters winning 2-1 against the Savannah Bananas. It was a day full of fanfare and celebrity appearances, with John Cena, Kane Brown and Pentatonix also joining the fun.

The Jonas Brothers last dropped an album in August 2025, reaching No. 6 on the Billboard 200 with Greetings From Your Hometown . Last month, they performed at the NFL game in Melbourne, Australia.
